# All-Star Renovations — Bathroom & Kitchen Remodeling in Central Arkansas

> All-Star Renovations is a licensed bathroom and kitchen remodeling contractor founded in 2014 by Thomas Pedersen and based in Conway, Arkansas. We specialize in grout-free shower systems, walk-in tubs, aging-in-place/ADA conversions, kitchen remodeling, and handyman services. Most projects install in 1-2 days with lifetime material warranties. Phone: (501) 504-3398. Service radius: 50 miles from Conway.

## Locations & Services
